# PulseRN

> Adaptive NCLEX-RN exam preparation, built by a licensed registered nurse.
> Web app at https://www.pulsern.app — installable to a phone home screen.

PulseRN is a study platform for nursing students and graduates preparing for
the NCLEX-RN licensure examination. It is educational exam preparation only and
is not medical advice, not a clinical reference, and not a source of real-world
dosing or treatment instructions.

## What it does

- **Adaptive practice.** An Elo/Rasch ability engine estimates a student's level
  from their answers and serves questions matched to it, interleaved across the
  eight NCSBN client-need categories.
- **Every Next Generation NCLEX item type.** Bow-tie, matrix, cloze, highlight,
  drag-and-drop, multiple response, dosage calculation, and standard multiple
  choice — with the NCJMM clinical-judgment flow on case studies.
- **Spaced-repetition flashcards.** Real calendar scheduling with a
  type-before-flip recall step rather than passive self-grading.
- **Case studies.** Multi-step unfolding patient scenarios across all eight
  categories, including dedicated pediatric and geriatric populations.
- **Readiness exams.** Ten standardized 85-question forms — the NCLEX-RN's
  minimum length — under a timed lockdown, never repeated to the same account.
- **Readiness estimate.** A deliberately conservative signal labeled an
  estimate, requiring a minimum answer count, that never promises an outcome.
- **AI tutor.** Explains why an answer is right or wrong, on demand.

## Honest limitations

- PulseRN is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the NCSBN.
  NCLEX® is a registered trademark of the National Council of State Boards of
  Nursing, Inc.
- The readiness estimate predicts nothing about an actual exam result. It is a
  study signal, not a forecast.
- Practice items are comparable to real exam items in style and rigor. They are
  never claimed to be identical to, drawn from, or predictive of live NCLEX
  content.
- Content is reviewed for clinical accuracy before publication. Students are
  told throughout to verify anything surprising against their course materials.

## Authorship and review

- Creator and clinical content owner: **Sheldon Bennett, RN**.
- Public author profile: https://www.pulsern.app/about/#sheldon-bennett-rn
- Human clinical review remains required for AI-assisted educational content.
- Method and limitations: https://www.pulsern.app/methodology/
- Editorial and correction policy: https://www.pulsern.app/editorial-policy/

## Access and pricing

- Free account required; progress syncs across devices.
- A 1-day free pass provides study-content access without a readiness exam.
- Paid access periods run from 30 to 730 days and include stated numbers of
  readiness self-assessments. Current prices: https://www.pulsern.app/pricing/
- Sign-in by email and password, or by passwordless email link.

## NCLEX preparation comparisons

Provider features and prices are sourced to provider-owned public pages and
carry an observation date. PulseRN publishes these pages about its own product,
uses no affiliate placement, and does not assign a universal winner or outcome
guarantee.
